profile.headline: Software Engineer | Microsoft
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with experience in C# (.Net Core, .Net Framework), Entity Framework, Classic ASP, ASP.NET, HTML, CSS, Javascript, Node.js, Bootstrap, SQL (PL SQL, MS SQL, MySQL), C, C++, Delphi, Git/GitHub, Azure, DevOps, Unity and Microsoft Office.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I am currently engaged in enhancing the Windows services suite, focusing on the active development of features utilizing programming languages such as C# and C++, along with tools like Git/GitHub, Azure, and PowerShell.
positions.insights: Skills: Garantia de qualidade de software · Design de software · Azure DevOps · Desenvolvimento de software · Gerenciamento de bugs · Windows Azure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I successfully developed and maintained a variety of systems, leveraging my expertise in C#, C++, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Classic ASP, Delphi, and web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 
My proficiency extends to database management with SQL, utilizing both PL/SQL and MS SQL. I used version control with Git/GitHub, cloud services via Azure, and I was well-versed in the methodologies of DevOps and Scrum.
